reviews.text:
Margherita, thank you so much for your feedback and for trusting us. We will continue working to improve and hope that your next visit will be even more enjoyable.

Best regards,
The Balmesvet Team 🐾

Today I visited the clinic because my partner's dog was sick. The care was excellent. I was lucky enough to be seen by Celia Prades, a lovely young woman who explained everything in detail and showed great empathy. We will definitely be back. A woman, I think she was Russian, also served us water, and since there weren't any plastic cups left, she brought us some bowls that are used by the staff. I'm really happy with all the staff.

We went to the emergency room early yesterday morning, and apart from the nurse who was lovely, the rest was very disappointing and worrying—the treatment (to put it mildly) my dog ​​received was awful. The doctor showed a terrible lack of empathy and tact. Anyway, be very careful where you choose to take your pets.

Excellent care and very good professionals, from the reception staff to the nurses and veterinarians. My cat is currently hospitalized, and although it's been 7 days, I've always received updates, clear communication, and my pet is in very good condition.

Our experience at this clinic has been deeply disappointing, especially due to the treatment we received during one of the most painful moments of our lives.

We took our 13-year-old dog in because he was very ill. They ran blood tests and informed us that he had pancreatitis and that his condition was serious.

The first veterinarian who saw us raised the possibility of hospitalizing him and literally told us that if it were his dog, he would admit him. At that moment, we were completely devastated, trying to understand what was happening and make the best possible decision for our dog. We felt that the way they suggested hospitalization didn't take into account his age, his condition, the suffering he was experiencing, or our emotional state.

We ultimately decided against admitting him. It was then that another veterinarian came in and, after learning that we had decided against it, explained things in a completely different and much clearer way: he told us that he was critical, that he was really sick, and that there was nothing they could do.

We asked him directly what the chances were if we decided to admit him. His answer was very clear: zero chance.

And this is where we find it especially difficult to understand what happened: it was the same dog, 13 years old, and the same test results. However, we were first told, "If it were my dog, I would admit him," and later another veterinarian told us clearly that there was nothing that could be done and that the chances of him surviving were zero.

We don't question being informed of the available medical options. What we question is the way it was done and the lack of empathy at such a delicate moment. When a family is about to say goodbye to their dog after 13 years, they need clear information, honesty, and sensitivity, not to feel pressured into making a particular decision.

In the end, we had to say goodbye to our dog. It was a heartbreaking decision, but we made it thinking about preventing him from suffering any more.

We hoped that in his final moments we would be accompanied with humanity and respect. Unfortunately, that was not our experience.

Our dog was 13 years old. After a lifetime by our side, he deserved to have his final moments treated with much more love, empathy, and sensitivity.

Traumatic experience. I would never recommend this clinic.

One evening I called because my dog was very ill, but they refused to see us and I was told to relax. A few hours later, I found my dog dead in the hallway of my home. In the middle of the night, devastated and in shock, I called the clinic again asking for help and guidance, but I received none.

I was surprised by the complete lack of compassion and support afterwards. I never heard from the clinic again. Not even a phone call to ask what had happened or to express condolences.

I am sharing my experience so that other pet owners are aware of how we were treated. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this practice.

Update:: I have reached out directly via email after I got a reply on my review. Balmesvet never responded to this email.

My 3-month-old cat had a very complicated operation. They were excellent professionals and treated us with great compassion. They kept us informed every step of the way and supported us through the difficult moments. Thanks to them, my Tete is a happy cat.

Although she wasn't my regular vet, I had to admit my cat as an emergency patient, and for a long time they treated him and guided me through his diabetes in a very professional manner.
They treated me with compassion, keeping me informed every step of the way, and showed genuine affection for our pets.

I don't usually write reviews, but I feel the need to share what happened:

I went to this establishment (BalmesVet) on Friday, September 11th, in an emergency shortly before 10 AM because my dog ​​had ingested chicken bones just minutes before. Time passed, and no one seemed to care. They just took my information and made me wait in a room... no one assessed him, observed him, or did anything for 45 minutes! No one.

Other dogs were being treated at the operating room, and then I saw a doctor in a blue coat go in and out with four coffees in his hand. In the background, I could hear a television (or a cell phone) and saw the doctors in blue coats going in and out. Another one said he was "going to breakfast and would be right back."

At 10:40 AM, I told the reception staff that if they had "other emergencies," I was leaving. They told me to wait another half hour, and I asked them, "Wait for what? For the doctors to have breakfast?" At that precise moment, my dog ​​started vomiting. I picked him up and made the best decision I could make at BalmesVet: GET OUT OF THERE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

At 10:47, I arrived at another hospital very close by, and at 10:49, they attended to him, assessed him, and he recovered shortly after!

In short: as other comments have shown, BalmesVet's routine negligence causes serious harm and suffering to an animal. It's not just a capricious wait... it's negligence, omission, and a lack of professional ethics.
Excellent clinical and personal care. Good price and honest service.

Good care overall, but excessively expensive!
To say the least, some services were highway robbery!
Prices were up to 80% higher! Fluid therapy cost €112/day, while at another excellent center like Anicura it's only €18! 😱 Everything is overpriced!
The first vet, Adrian, was very nice but lacked empathy!

However, I can say that overall she received good care, but I won't be going back!
For me, it's ANICURA!

I recently had an issue with an appointment. After resolving it, and at the request of customer service, I deleted the review I had posted. Now I see that it was probably a mistake.

Since then, I've been trying to get my dog's test results. At first, they only sent me one. After three reminders, they sent me another report, but it was old: it corresponded to tests done a year ago, not the current ones.

I have no complaints about the veterinarians themselves, but the reception management is a complete disaster. The lack of attention, control, and rigor is unacceptable, especially when it comes to medical documentation. If they can't even locate and correctly send the results of a single test, it's inevitable to wonder what guarantees there are that the samples won't be mixed up or that the results for another animal won't be sent.

Alfredo, we appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your trust; we're here for anything you need.
Balmesvet Team

Absolutely SHOCKING experience!

I brought my dog here after he suddenly collapsed and was struggling to breathe. We were left sitting in the waiting room for 3 hours until 1am. When I finally asked what was happening, I was told the vet had forgotten about us and that I should judge for myself whether my dog was okay!!!??

I was also asked whether I was a foreigner??? which made the way we were treated even more concerning.

We left immediately and went to another vet, where my dog was assessed straight away, thank god, as this turned out to be serious.

If you are understaffed or cannot deal with an emergency, send people somewhere that can. Don’t leave an animal waiting for hours and tell the owner to decide whether it’s serious.

And honestly, after this experience, I have to wonder how many of these great reviews here are actually genuine.

Absolutely unacceptable!! I would not trust this hospital with ANY animal!!

One of the worst experiences I've ever had at a veterinary hospital.

We arrived at night with my dog ​​in a worrying state: severe diarrhea, vomiting, and weakness. There were practically no other clients waiting, and yet we waited for over two hours without being seen. During all that time, my dog ​​simply waited with me without receiving any assistance.

The only thing I sincerely want to thank the staff for is that, as I don't speak Spanish well, several employees tried to help me with translation. I really appreciate that.

Unfortunately, that's where the positive aspects of my experience end.

During the hospitalization, they promised us several times that they would call us to update us on the dog's condition, his progress, and the treatment. In practice, I had to get almost all the information myself by constantly following up via WhatsApp or phone. Many times they promised to call and simply didn't.

When we went for a previously scheduled appointment to see our dog and speak with the veterinarian, we again waited for over two hours. At one point, we felt like they had simply forgotten about us. Furthermore, they returned the dog to us completely covered in feces. It was especially unpleasant for me to see him like that after he had been hospitalized for two days, supposedly under observation.

According to the tests performed, my dog ​​had pancreatitis, moderate colitis, enteritis, and gastritis. Despite this, after two days of hospitalization, he was discharged with severe diarrhea. Once home, blood appeared in his stool, he had to go outside to defecate practically every 1–2 hours throughout the night, and he barely wanted to eat.

The most worrying thing was what happened after his discharge. We tried to contact the clinic repeatedly because we were very concerned about his condition. We called during the night when blood appeared in his stool, but we couldn't get through to anyone. Finally, I had to seek help from other veterinarians and incur further expenses to continue his treatment.

Another major problem has been the paperwork. It's been over a day since my dog ​​was discharged, and I'm still having to repeatedly request the full hospitalization report, which I need both for my insurance and so another veterinarian can properly assess the case. They've sent me the lab results and the ultrasound report, but that doesn't replace a complete hospitalization/discharge report detailing the reason for admission, the dog's progress, the treatments and medications administered, and the animal's condition at the time of discharge. I've requested it repeatedly and still haven't received it.

Furthermore, today they told me again that they would call to check on my dog ​​after discharge. No one called.

For the price I pay at this hospital, I expected at least adequate communication, patient follow-up, and much more attentive treatment of both the animal and its owner. Instead, my experience has been a series of long waits, unfulfilled promises of calls, and the constant need to chase after basic information about my own dog.

My personal impression is that the financial side of things works much faster and more efficiently than communication with owners and patient follow-up.

After this experience, I cannot recommend this hospital. If anyone decides to go there, my advice is to personally oversee absolutely everything: constantly ask about the animal's condition, request all documentation, review every treatment, and don't assume they will call you even if they have promised to do so several times.

My experience has not been positive. The waiting times are incredibly long, regardless of whether you go at 10:30 pm or 3:00 pm. I've gone twice for emergencies with my cat, and I've had to wait at least 3-4 hours. They take you to a cubicle, there's a triage, and then the interminable wait begins. They have insufficient veterinarians, the medical report isn't given out immediately and is sent later, but days go by and nothing arrives. If you call to ask about an emergency that was treated and you're already home with a prescription, they take your note but don't return your call. Honestly, I don't recommend this veterinary clinic; the service is unfortunately substandard.

Jessica, thank you so much for your feedback. Knowing that your experience at Balmesvet has been positive is very important to the whole team and encourages us to continue working with the same dedication every day.

Best regards,
The Balmesvet Team 🐾

Alba, thank you so much for your feedback. We're here for anything you need.

Best regards, Balmesvet Team

My dog was diagnosed with the terminal stage of a very aggressive form of cancer, and there wasn't much could be done. With a broken heart we chose the option of euthanasia.

But the empathy, attitude and professionalism of the staff made this extremely sad experience so much softer for us.

With all my heart I want to say thanks to our doctors. Mar, Patricia and Coco, you are great professionals and what's more important — very good humans. Keep up being awesome!

Mauricio, thank you so much for your feedback and for trusting our team.

Best regards,
Balmesvet Team 🐾 …
Good professionals and good service!

Hello Carlos,
We've seen your review and would like to know what happened so we can understand the reason for your experience with us.

We tried to contact you by phone, but we weren't able to reach you. Therefore, we'll send you an email so you can tell us what happened, if you'd like.

We'd like to hear about your experience and review any aspects you feel are important to bring to our attention.

Best regards,

Balmesvet Team

I went there in an emergency. With my dog. The receptionists were very kind, as was the vet. They saw me very quickly. I was very happy and they solved my dog's problem.
I recommend them. I went because it was Saturday and my vet is closed on weekends, but I had been warned. If you have any problems on the weekend, go to Balmesvet.
Nurse Alexandra was an angel during a tough time. I recommend her and won’t forget her kindness.

We went to this hospital confident that our dog, diagnosed with lymphoma, would receive the best possible treatment. However, our experience was very different from what we expected.

The oncologist told us that our dog wasn't responding to the treatment and that it should be discontinued. This was devastating news for us. Furthermore, the corticosteroid treatment was abruptly stopped, even though other professionals had later explained that it should be done gradually.

Faced with this situation, we decided to seek a second opinion at another hospital. There, they reviewed the case and decided to continue with the same treatment protocol that had been initially prescribed. The difference was that, at this new hospital, the treatment guidelines were followed correctly.

Today, a year later, our dog is still alive and fighting his lymphoma. Thank God we decided to seek a second opinion.

We're not writing this review out of resentment, but because we believe our experience can help other families. When an animal's life is at stake, a second opinion can make a huge difference.

We wish the decisions made at this hospital had been different, because the consequences could have been irreversible.

We want to clarify several points:

Don't try to twist the facts. The first professional who saw Leo was a surgeon, who suggested removing the lymph nodes and even provided us with a quote.
Later, the oncology department intervened and told us it wasn't necessary to remove them, which created a completely contradictory situation for us.
Regarding the corticosteroid, we consulted with several professionals and were told that it shouldn't be stopped abruptly, but rather following a proper schedule.
During Leo's care, tests were performed that we consider unnecessary for his condition, even requiring him to be anesthetized when he was already fragile.
Furthermore, Leo had a slight heart murmur, a circumstance that should also have been taken into account before subjecting him to certain tests and anesthesia.
We have reports, tests, and documentation that prove what happened.

We don't want to get into a public argument or turn this into a confrontation. We simply want to make it clear that this was our experience, and we stand by what we stated in our review.

We believe there was mismanagement of Leo's case, and we will not allow what happened to be misrepresented.

The only thing that matters to us now is that Leo continues to fight and receives the appropriate treatment.

They're the best. I've been taking my dog ​​Cereza there for 12 years whenever I need to. They're incredibly professional, very kind, and friendly. Everyone, from the reception staff to the veterinarians, without exception. Thank you so much for your dedication! 🐾 …

I'm giving one star because I can't give zero. After two visits to different veterinarians, both told me the dog needed to go to an emergency hospital for a problem with his left hind leg, and the sooner the better. One of the vets recommended this clinic. I arrived at 6:00 PM, it's now 10:00 PM, and no one has attended to me, not even looked at the dog to give him a basic assessment or ask if I should wait for any tests. At 10:00 PM, I went back to reception, and incredibly, there was no one there. The clinic was empty; there was only one other couple and me, no one else, and a doctor, I think, wandering around without attending to anyone. So I picked up the dog and left. It's a disgrace and I'm so upset I can't express it as I'd like. I hope nothing happens to the animal. Thank you.
We have been there ten times and always with very good attention from the veterinarians.

This is the second time I've taken my dog ​​to the emergency vet. After waiting for about two hours, without them even assessing the severity of the problem, I had to go somewhere else. There, they finally performed an initial examination to determine whether she could wait or not, given the serious tear in her throat.
We won't be going back to Balmesvet.

Thank you, Rodolfo, for your feedback. Rodolfo, thank you for trusting us and leaving this review.

Best regards,
Balmesvet Team 🐾
They're fantastic. The service is really attentive and friendly. The place is large and very well-equipped.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency room because he was having trouble climbing stairs, was very unmotivated, had limited mobility, and was shaking. The vet touched him very briefly and concluded that he had hurt his back. Then they took blood (which I later learned was probably not really necessary for the type of symptoms he was having) and prescribed two anti-inflammatories at the same time.
They charged me €315, an absolutely disproportionate amount.
A week later, because my dog ​​was not getting better, I went to another vet. And it turns out that he had not hurt his back, but his NECK! This vet correctly identified the problem and charged me only €40.
The place itself is not bad, but the prices are completely outrageous and, on top of that, the incorrect diagnosis cost us €315
Friendly, competent and empathetic staff. Support in difficult times and advice contextualized to the situation of the animal and the family.

Abigail, thank you for your review and for trusting us. We're so glad to hear your experience at Balmesvet was so positive.

Hugs,
The Balmesvet Team 🐾

I'm giving it a 1 because there's no 0. The staff seems friendly, but they're mostly salespeople, UNETHICAL, just trying to make money at the expense of your pets.

In short, I took my senior cat there, and in 3 days they performed 3 catheterizations with 3 sedations, a blood transfusion, 3 ultrasounds, 2 x-rays, countless blood tests, and general anesthesia that they thankfully aborted because it would have cost my friend his life. I think if I had more time, I should file a complaint because it's outrageous, and I've seen similar cases from this same place, unfortunately.
They charged me over 2,000 euros in 3 days for diagnostic tests just to make money, only to come up with something completely wrong. They only harmed him with so many tests and anesthesias, and he came out much worse than when he went in. Please don't go! They have few scruples, and they'll squeeze every last penny out of you. Your pet is just a business to them. They are very friendly, and above all, they have one thing very clear: making money. I'm not surprised by so many reviews from people saying their kitten died here. Fortunately, I went to another place where they simply and professionally diagnosed what my cat had and improved him the next day. I must clarify that my cat DOES NOT HAVE, NOR HAS EVER HAD, ANY URINARY STONES. They subjected him to all those procedures that almost cost him his life just to get money out of me. He was quite affected and still has lingering effects, but he never had what they diagnosed. If you love your pet, please don't go there. A clinic to avoid at all costs.

Cristina, thank you for your feedback. It's a great motivation for the whole team to receive a review like yours.

Hugs,
Team Balmesvet 🐾

The other day I took my partner's dog to the emergency vet, and the receptionist, the vet, and the assistant (I think their names were Andrea and Adriana) were all very kind and understanding. The vet explained everything really well, and now our little one is home and we have a hospital we can trust!
I was delighted with the empathy and treatment, both towards the pets and their owners, honest in their diagnoses and very quick and efficient in their emergency service.
Monica, neurologist, 100% recommended, lovely person
I took my dog ​​for her annual check-up and everything went really well. The staff is very friendly and explains everything in detail.

Service of 10. Affectionate and good professionals.
Thanks for everything.

Hi Elisabeth,
Thank you so much for sharing your feedback. We'll continue working to make your next visit even better.

Best regards,
The Balmesvet Team 🐾

I went a long time ago when my 18 year old cat could only eat AD cans because she didn't have teeth
She was very thin and was breathing badly... she was dying.
Due to my carelessness... I didn't have a can for her. And I went one evening. From the emergency room.
They told me to wait for me.... they passed everyone in front of me. 'A can doesn't give money"
They passed a dog that had snot.
I left. Because 30 min. They were already laughing at me.

They didn't even pay attention to me.
Very professional, very fast, excellent service.

Hello David.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and for trusting us. We regret that the price wasn't what you expected. At Balmesvet, we strive to provide care based on medical criteria, dedicating the time and resources each patient needs. Before performing any procedure, we always provide a cost estimate so that each pet owner can make an informed decision.

We hope to offer you a better experience on future visits. The Balmesvet Team

My dog ​​received emergency care at BalmesVet while I was away, and the person caring for her received excellent treatment. Despite the distance, the veterinarian kept me informed at all times, clearly explaining what had happened, the procedure performed, and the recommended treatment.

I also want to highlight the attention of the entire support team. Whenever I called the clinic, I received a prompt response and was able to speak with the veterinarian whenever I needed to, to make decisions about the procedure and monitor her progress.

Two weeks after the accident, my dog ​​is practically recovered and doing very well. We are very grateful for the professionalism, the personal touch, and the care we received throughout the entire process. I wholeheartedly recommend BalmesVet.

Your approach to care and work has been slow and agonizing, both for the patient and for his guardian. The lack of internal communication has resulted in a worrying lack of rigor when conveying the diagnosis and making treatment decisions.

I am deeply disappointed with how my cat's case has been handled. An animal in such a critical condition should have a better chance of survival in a hospital with your resources and infrastructure, or at the very least, receive appropriate treatment in a timely manner.

You were the ones who set the treatment plan and made the clinical decisions. As his guardian, I trusted your judgment completely. That is why it is especially painful to feel that this trust was not matched by the diligence, coordination, and rigor that such a serious situation demanded.

I believe you have excellent veterinary professionals at your center. However, my impression is that the organization, the prioritization, and the ethics with which this case has been handled are clearly geared toward business criteria over animal welfare. And I believe that contradicts the very reason for a veterinary clinic's existence: to ensure, above all else, the health, well-being, and dignity of the animals that come to it.
They are very affectionate with my cat Chispas, and the checkups are good.

Hi Nihan,
Thank you for taking a few seconds to rate us. The whole team really appreciates your trust.

Best regards,
Team Balmesvet 🐾

Hi Ariana,
Thank you so much for your feedback. We're glad to hear your experience with us was positive.

Best regards,
The Balmesvet Team 🐾
Excellent professionals, they treated us very well and took great care of my dog.

A terrible experience. I arrived with my 16-year-old dog in very bad shape; she was dying. They recommended hospitalization, tests, analyses, a whole lot of things, when I would have appreciated a recommendation for gentle sedation. It lasted three terrible hours, with us being rushed around in those vulnerable moments. It wasn't the ending I wanted, and they didn't advise me properly. In those difficult times, I would have preferred to have her sedated and spend her last moments with her, as there was nothing else to do but wait for the end.

Carlota's treatment has been excellent. She is a great professional and, above all, a person with exceptional human qualities. Her closeness, empathy and dedication make the experience unbeatable. Thank you very much for everything!

Hi Joan,
Thank you so much for your feedback. We're glad to have your trust.

Balmesvet Team 🐾
The staff were very attentive and took great care of our pets, although the prices are a bit high.

On Sunday, my dog ​​started vomiting all the water he drank after an hour at the beach. I went to Balmes Vet because I was scared, as he was still vomiting what he drank at 3 pm and I thought he would become dehydrated. Charging 506 euros for a visit, blood work, and x-ray that they couldn't even do seems excessive. According to the report summary, the dog had a great appetite and was very active during the consultation, which seems like a joke, especially considering they mentioned admitting him that same day. In short, I don't know what's wrong with him. I imagine heatstroke, indigestion, but I'm only guessing since the report doesn't detail anything. They'll tell me they gave me a quote during the consultation, but at that moment, when the dog vomited four times in a row at the clinic and another ten times before going in, I would have said yes even if they asked for double, and that's what you're playing with. I know this is how it is, but this amount is half of some salaries in this country. You'll see I'm not naming names; I'm not being rude or insulting. I am simply describing a situation involving an excessively high price and a report that even my own veterinarian doesn't understand.

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for the care we received during the diagnosis and treatment of our dog, Thor, who was diagnosed with lymphoma.

From the very beginning, Lidia, the oncologist, explained everything to us clearly and compassionately. She dedicated time to us, answered all our questions, and was always honest with us. In such a difficult process, receiving clear and honest information is essential, and that's exactly what we experienced every step of the way.
Unfortunately, Thor's condition deteriorated too quickly. Despite our best efforts, he passed away on February 13th. Even so, we felt supported and respected in every decision. We never felt pressured; on the contrary, we allowed ourselves to be guided by her experience and our own feelings, knowing that we had her support at all times.
Lidia was with us until the very end, and that is something we will always be grateful for. We are left with the peace of mind of having been well-advised and supported throughout the entire process.
Thank you for your professionalism, humanity, and empathy during one of the most difficult times of our lives.

The best center in Barcelona.
They take excellent care of Noa🐶.
A great team of professionals and wonderful people.
Thank you so much. …
Thank you so much for your feedback. We will continue working with the same dedication to care for each patient and their family. Best regards, The Balmesvet Team.
We've been clients of Balmes Vet for over 15 years and have always received excellent care for our dogs. A highly recommended service. 🔝 …

I had a serious problem with my dog ​​and thanks to the experience and professionalism of the entire team everything went smoothly. I must say that all the staff are very nice and affectionate with the furry ones and the facilities are very good.

Hi Raquel, thank you for your feedback. We're glad to hear you had a good experience. Best regards. See you soon.

Balmesvet Team
Extremely helpful and friendly! Open 24 hours

My review is for Dr. Sara, the surgeon.
She operated on my cat for a sarcoma in a complex area on the front of his head. Her care and follow-up were excellent, and the surgery was a success. Thank you.
Hi Jorge, thank you so much for your feedback. We're here for anything you need. Best regards, Balmesvet Team

Thank you, Daniel, for the 5 stars. We're glad you trust Balmesvet.

Best regards, The Balmesvet Team
Thank you, Josep, for your feedback. We appreciate your trust. Best regards, Balmesvet Team
Núria has been exceptional with my kittens who are terrified of leaving the house and being transported.
Excellent service and treatment

Excellent professionals who treat pets and their families very well. They also avoid overmedicating pets with unjustified drugs and are careful with tests, only performing them when necessary and not just doing them unnecessarily.

We visited this clinic for follow-up care for my dog ​​Kyra, who had cancer. We saw Dr. Lidia Regaño Otal from the oncology department, who gave us a very honest diagnosis for Kyra and was very empathetic throughout, always available to answer our questions. We also saw Dr. Héctor Pérez Martín from the traumatology department, who was also with Kyra and was equally understanding and empathetic. For the short time Kyra was in their care, they were very professional and concerned about our dog's well-being, ensuring she was pain-free during her final months. Finally, we thanked Dr. Monica, who assisted with Kyra's euthanasia. She was very professional and gave us the necessary time to say goodbye. And we also thank the administrative staff who handled all the paperwork for the cremation and certificates.

Thank you so much for all the support and empathy we received from you.

Thanks to Andrea for sharing her valuable knowledge and consulting us ♥️
We came with our cat and were so worried and scared, but now thanks to this visit, everything is under control and we are calm.

Even though we went there for an emergency, they treated us quickly. Very friendly treatment from both the assistants and the veterinarians. Mónica treated us brilliantly and with lots of love. Thank you very much!
Always 10/10 attention with my timid furry friend.

I couldn't be happier with this team! I've had to go there a couple of times for emergencies, and besides treating my kitties with incredible care and professionalism, they've made me feel super calm during very stressful moments. You can tell they love what they do. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my little ones!

Very disappointed!

The management and organization were terrible. I had to explain to four different veterinarians on different days why my cat was hospitalized.
I was very surprised that they didn't read or even ask the veterinarian who referred his medical history.
They performed tests, none of which were clear.
And then they claim to care about animals when they can't even be informed. My cat had an inflamed anal gland. I picked him up today and saw that they hadn't even bothered to clean it.
The dark-haired receptionist with curly hair (Leyla or Laya, if I remember correctly) was incredibly rude. I asked for the report so I knew what I was paying, and right in front of me, she called the veterinarian to tell her she didn't want to pay… Wow! I never said that. Is wanting to know what you're paying for wrong?
I asked because I had previously told one of the veterinarians not to perform two tests. They said they were going to send me the breakdown and they didn't. I had to call to get it sent, and they sent me the same one again. When it arrived, I asked for it, and they still didn't have it. I don't know, but that lack of communication and asking for the report made me angry.
What kind of professionals are these?!
How little they care.
They didn't treat me with any seriousness, and how can I trust someone who doesn't even know what my pet had? They called me to connect me to something my vet and I were already discussing, something we explained from the beginning.

READ EACH PATIENT'S MEDICAL HISTORY FIRST, BE CLEAR WITH PEOPLE, AND STOP BEING ON SURVEILLANCE JUST SO THEY KEEP PAYING!

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to Oriol at Balmesvet for the impeccable care he has always given us.
He has been incredibly attentive to our dog Kira's health, looking after her every step of the way. Throughout her pancreatitis, we felt incredibly supported and cared for by him.

Furthermore, he has shown endless patience with her diet, searching and trying different options without giving up until he found a nutrition plan that Kira enjoyed and, above all, tolerated well. He is an empathetic, dedicated, and compassionate professional.

I wholeheartedly recommend both him and the clinic.
Excellent service and great care for my dog!
Amazing!!!🤩 staff was SUPER nice, informed and helpful!! …

A specialized feline center offering stress-free and comfortable consultations. They are very patient and take all the time your cat needs. Their emergency service is also excellent. I take my two cats there; they feel very comfortable with the place and the staff.

I managed to get two pieces out, and my dog ​​started making strange movements with his tongue and trying to help himself with his paw. My partner and I checked his mouth and couldn't see anything, nor did he seem to be choking, but he continued with the strange movements, so we looked for the nearest veterinary clinic and found this one! We were incredibly lucky; they helped us immediately, being super kind and patient with my dog ​​and me, as I was very nervous imagining a piece of bone tearing my little dog apart inside.
